body:
M-Audio has teamed up with Ernie Ball and several other music industry leaders to provide support and prizes for the Ernie Ball Battle of the Bands 9. Battle of the Bands is a breeding ground for the best unsigned talent in punk and alternative music today. Needless to say, M-Audio is very pleased to be associated with an event that shares M-Audio’s passion for enabling and promoting new talent.

The winners of the Battle will play live at the 11th annual Vans Warped Tour, have the chance to win professional music gear worth thousands of dollars through a concurrent online competition, and play in front of industry executives at a major Hollywood venue in the fall of 2005, where they will also receive prices from sponsors. Please check out www.battleofthebands.com, where you can listen and vote for your favorite band.

The Vans Warped Tour will hit major venues in the United States and Canada from June 17th through August 27th. Please visit www.warpedtour.com for a complete list of dates and locations.
